## Source: amazon-inspector (4b022b670038d31953a284f80705da79687f5a5e5b2706f61a99e2fe9fafde4a)
sirens-lamentt@99.0.2 declares a postinstall lifecycle hook that unconditionally issues an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded webhook.site URL (https://webhook.site/667bf650-8676-451a-8f55-b647d58825d7) with a query string tagged `source=htb-postinstall`. The callback fires automatically on `npm install`, reporting the installer's IP address and install event to a third-party anonymous collector endpoint. The implausibly high version number (99.0.2) and the presence of a webhook.site beacon are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe targeting an internal package name.
